issue_records.title: JuliaFormatter v2 deletes comments
issue_records.body_excerpt:
This is frankly quite bad:
```julia-repl
julia> using JuliaFormatter

julia> println(format_text("#= this is a valuable comment =#"))


julia> pkgversion(JuliaFormatter)
v"2.1.0"
```

defect_evidence_basis.assessment: Issue includes a public format_text reproducer that deletes a valuable comment; the single-parent fixing commit directly fixes the issue.

issue_records.title: Fix comments issues
issue_records.body_excerpt:
I don't exactly remember why I commented this out in the first place. I believe it was because I was working on getting these to be treated as regular args wrapped in comments but it there was a issue with regular multiline comments.

fix #909
